Okay so the worst thing that happened to me on that trip was in a restaurant, and it was my own fault. I have an allergy, a bad one, to nuts. And I did not say anything because I was embarrassed about my English. The waiter recommended a dessert and I just said yes. And then it arrived and it was covered in pistachios. I did not eat it, obviously, but I felt so stupid, because the whole thing would have taken me one sentence. Now I say it first, before anything else. If the menu is not clear, I ask. If they do not have something without nuts, I order the fruit. It is not complicated. It was just scary the first time.

Good evening. Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes? Right. So the moussaka is our house dish, and I would recommend it, but I should tell you it is a very large portion, so perhaps share it between two. If you want something lighter, the grilled fish comes with salad. Now, about the pistachio dessert you asked for. I am afraid it is not available tonight, but if you like, I can bring you the yoghurt with honey instead. It is the same price. And I will bring you a receipt at the end, of course. Anything to drink while you decide?
